A decision guide to Fp-Ts: what it is for, when it fits, how to start, and which compatibility or maintenance details deserve a closer look.

Quick verdict

Best fit — and when to skip it

Fp-Ts is most relevant to developers working with JavaScript/TypeScript. Its source topics point to typescript, algebraic data types, functional programming. It belongs on a shortlist when that stated purpose matches a concrete requirement.

Skip or postpone it when the documented runtime, license, dependency footprint, or maintenance model conflicts with your project. Popularity alone is not a reason to migrate.

Setup and first checks

Confirm the exact package name, current version, runtime requirement, dependencies, provenance, and release notes before installing fp-ts in a production project. Start in a disposable example and exercise the use case you actually need.

Bottom line
